assistant_markdown:
Converted to a creature while preserving the fervent, rallying “zeal”
theme. Renamed using the flavor’s Cantor, added appropriate creature
types, removed Saga-specific layout/keywords, and rewrote abilities into
ETB/attack/combat-damage triggers that echo the original chapters at a
low power level.

modified_card_json.name: Cantor of the Dawn-Fire
modified_card_json.text:
When Cantor of the Dawn-Fire enters the battlefield, create a 1/1 red and white Human Soldier creature token with haste. That token attacks this turn if able.
Whenever Cantor of the Dawn-Fire attacks, other creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. Cantor of the Dawn-Fire gains first strike until end of turn.
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
"Set your doubts alight, and march." —Cantor of the Dawn-Fire
